reviewSamples.author: Photo of Breianna Bonds EL
reviewSamples.text: I want to start by saying excellent service! I booked my daughters 1st birthday photo shoot and the pictures came out amazing. We had time for an outfit change and the edits came back so fast! Definitely going to book again for myself and my daughter!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Bamela Anderson
reviewSamples.text: Best work I’ve ever had! Perfection at its finest and affordable! I wouldn’t go anywhere else in Miami. She’s professional but makes you feel so comfortable while shooting . To add, I’ve had professional pictures and family photos done. She’s amazing for any look you want to accomplish in your photos.
